_comment: Discipline + scalp tunables. The reflection engine edits exactly ONE per cycle, archives the prior version to state/history/, logs a falsifiable hypothesis, and REVERTS it next cycle if the score got worse — so only profit-improving values are kept. unified_trader.py reads the scalp_* values LIVE.

night_trade_block._why: Excluding 22:00-08:00 BROKER-SERVER time flipped the user's real manual record from -$18 to +$904 (PF 3.36) — the single strongest edge. Hours are broker/server time (the user's chart clock, currently UTC+3), the SAME frame MT5 deal timestamps use. The live Python gate converts now-UTC to server via server_utc_offset_hours; the EA reads server time natively (DST-proof). BTCUSDm exempt: crypto trades 24/7 by design (genome session_filter=[]). NOTE: server_utc_offset_hours may need to flip 3->2 if the broker observes EET/EEST winter time.

_scalp_comment: LIVE scalping knobs read by unified_trader.py every entry scan (no restart needed). The reflection engine hill-climbs these: nudges ONE per cycle, keeps it if the next cycle's profit score improved, reverts it if it got worse. This is how it 'learns the profitable values and saves them'.

_self_tune._note: When enabled, reflect.py explores the scalp_* knobs (round-robin, one per cycle) in addition to the discipline rules. Profitable nudges are kept; harmful ones auto-revert. Run continuously with: python reflection\reflect.py --fallback --loop --interval 600

_scalp_1plus3_note: 2026-05-30 USER '1+3': disciplined conviction + proven sizing + let-winners-run (trail-tighten keys removed → wide ladder). The reflection hill-climber may re-tune FROM here on measured profit (honest).
_scalp_mode_note: 2026-05-30 USER: confident scalping + same-symbol stacking into strength (conf>=0.72 add, green book, same side). First entry gate 0.55 (clear setup); moderate scalp trail.
